title: THE HOUSE THAT WORDS BUILT IS NOT A CLAIM ABOUT MAGIC WORDS; IT IS A QUESTION ABOUT WHETHER THE CHAIN FROM SENTENCE TO MATTER CAN BE COMPUTATIONALLY CLOSED.
SHRDLU MAKES AN ORDINARY ENGLISH SENTENCE CAUSALLY UPSTREAM OF A CHANGED WORLD-STATE.
WINOGRAD’S LATER LANGUAGE/ACTION WORK MOVES OPERATIVITY FROM COMMAND EXECUTION TO THE SOCIAL ORGANIZATION OF COMMITMENT.
EASTMAN’S BUILDING DESCRIPTION SYSTEM MOVES THE BUILDING FROM A SET OF DRAWINGS INTO A COMPUTABLE DATA STRUCTURE.
GLIDE MAKES “LANGUAGE FOR BUILDING” LITERAL BY DEFINING A PROGRAMMING ENVIRONMENT FOR REPRESENTING PHYSICAL SYSTEMS IN DESIGN-AND-CONSTRUCTION DETAIL.
SHAPE GRAMMAR MAKES GRAMMAR GENERATE SPACE DIRECTLY: THE PRIMITIVES ARE SHAPES, NOT WORDS.
APT GIVES LANGUAGE STATEMENTS MACHINING SEMANTICS: PROGRAM TEXT CAN TERMINATE IN PHYSICAL TOOL MOTION.
ALEXANDER’S PATTERN LANGUAGE GENERATES BUILDING DESIGNS WITHOUT BEING AN EXECUTABLE PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE.
THE “PATTERN LANGUAGE” TRAVELS FROM ARCHITECTURE INTO SOFTWARE, BUT WHAT TRAVELS IS REUSABLE DESIGN KNOWLEDGE RATHER THAN EXECUTABLE SYNTAX.
NEGROPONTE MAKES CONVERSATION ITSELF AN ARCHITECTURAL INTERFACE: THE COMPUTER IS IMAGINED AS A DESIGN PARTNER RATHER THAN A PASSIVE DRAFTING DEVICE.
HEIDEGGER’S “HOUSE OF BEING” MAKES HUMANS GUARDIANS OF LANGUAGE, NOT BUILDERS THROUGH LANGUAGE.
FOR HEIDEGGER, BUILDING DOES NOT LEAD TO DWELLING; BUILDING IS ALREADY A MODE OF DWELLING.
WITTGENSTEIN PUTS THE HOUSES INSIDE LANGUAGE: LANGUAGE IS AN ACCRETED CITY, NOT A SINGLE HOUSE.
ALBERTI SPLITS BUILDING BETWEEN LINEAMENTS AND STRUCTURE: THE REPRESENTATION CAN PRESCRIBE FORM WITHOUT BEING THE BUILDING.
AUSTIN MAKES WORDS OPERATIVE ONLY INSIDE FELICITOUS ARRANGEMENTS OF PEOPLE, PROCEDURES, CIRCUMSTANCES, AND OTHER ACTIONS.
EVANS LOCATES ARCHITECTURAL POWER IN THE GAP BETWEEN REPRESENTATION AND BUILDING, NOT IN THEIR IDENTITY.
GOODMAN’S WORLDS ARE NOT MADE FROM NOTHING: WORLDMAKING BEGINS WITH OTHER WORLDS AND OPERATES AS REMAKING.
GOODMAN’S FORMULA DOES NOT PRIVILEGE WORDS: WORLDS REQUIRE “WORDS OR OTHER SYMBOLS.”
THE SENTENCE-TO-WALL PIPELINE BECOMES HYLOMORPHIC WHEN IT TREATS SOURCE DESCRIPTION AND FINISHED MATTER AS THE ONLY STATES THAT MATTER.
INGOLD TURNS MATERIAL EXECUTION INTO A QUESTION-AND-RESPONSE LOOP RATHER THAN THE TERMINAL STAGE OF A PROGRAM.
THE BUILDER OCCUPIES THE GAP BETWEEN THE COMPUTABLE BUILDING AND THE BUILDING THAT WEATHER, MATERIALS, AND USE KEEP CHANGING.
MEDIEVAL BUILDING MAKES DESIGN AN OPERATION WITHIN CONSTRUCTION RATHER THAN A COMPLETE REPRESENTATION BEFORE IT.
INGOLD’S CHARTRES CASE ATTACKS THE ASSUMPTION THAT SUFFICIENTLY COMPLETE RULES CAN SUBSTITUTE FOR WORKMANSHIP.
THE TECHNICAL DRAWING CAN STORE AN INSTRUCTION WITHOUT CONTAINING THE MOVEMENT REQUIRED TO EXECUTE IT.
INGOLD SPLITS LANGUAGE INTO TWO OPERATIVE MODES: SPECIFICATIONS DEFINE PROJECTS; STORIES ORIENT PRACTITIONERS THROUGH UNFINISHED SITUATIONS.
DESIGN NEED NOT PREDICT THE FINAL HOUSE; IT CAN PROJECT FAR ENOUGH AHEAD TO LET MAKING FIND ITS NEXT MOVE.
DEFERRED FORMALIZATION HAS AN OLDER DESIGN LOGIC: DESIGN CAN ANTICIPATE WITHOUT PRE-SPECIFYING THE FINAL FORM.
THE GENERATION LOOP IS NOT JUST ERROR CORRECTION IF THE ARTIFACT CAN REVEAL A FORM THAT WAS NEVER PRESENT IN THE INITIAL INTENTION.
A PROMPT MAY WORK NOT BY SPECIFYING THE RESULT BUT BY GIVING A CAPABLE SYSTEM ENOUGH GUIDANCE TO CONTINUE.
INGOLD’S “EVERY TECHNICAL GESTURE IS A QUESTION” MAKES EXECUTION ITSELF A SPECIFICATION-PRODUCING ACT.
THE LOOP BECOMES NECESSARY WHERE RULES CAN GUIDE ACTION BUT CANNOT PREORDAIN WHAT THE SITUATION WILL REQUIRE.
A CONSTRAINT MAY BE BETTER UNDERSTOOD AS THE HISTORY OF WHAT HAPPENED UNDER TEST THAN AS A STATIC ATTRIBUTE OF THE DESIRED OUTPUT.
THE ROOF PROBLEM IS NOT JUST THAT FAILURE MUST BE LEGIBLE; THE MATERIAL WORLD MUST BE ALLOWED TO INVALIDATE THE MODEL.
“THE PROMPT IS NOT THE PROGRAM” BECOMES STRONGER IF PROGRAMMING IS LOCATED IN THE INTERLEAVING OF DESCRIPTION AND EXECUTION RATHER THAN IN EITHER ONE ALONE.
THE PLAN IS NOT THE SHOT: ONE WORLD REQUIRES REPRESENTATIONS WITH DIFFERENT JURISDICTIONS

EXIT OCCUPANCY MAKES THE PREVIOUS WORLD STATE PART OF THE NEXT SENTENCE
A SCREEN IS NOT A ROOM BECAUSE ITS NATIVE CONTACT IS TEMPORAL
THE ROUTE PRECEDES THE PLAT: REPEATED MOVEMENT CAN OUTRANK THE LEGAL MAP AS A SHOTCALLER
SHRDLU’S ENGLISH ACTS ONLY BECAUSE THE WORLD HAS ALREADY BEEN PARTLY BUILT INTO THE INTERPRETER
INGOLD AND WINOGRAD MEET AT THE LIMIT OF THE MODEL, NOT AT THE POWER OF LANGUAGE
TURING DOES NOT SAY THE MACHINE BUILDER CREATES THE SOUL; HE IMAGINES BUILDERS PROVIDING A MANSION IN WHICH SOMETHING ELSE MAY DWELL.
WITTGENSTEIN MAKES LANGUAGE A CITY WITH NEW REGULAR SUBURBS; PROMPT SYSTEMS MAY BE A NEW DISTRICT RATHER THAN A UNIVERSAL LANGUAGE.
THE FUNDAMENTAL SYNTAX OF THE SUBURBAN HOUSE MAY BE DEONTIC: MAY, MUST, SHALL, AND SHALL NOT.
A SENTENCE BECOMES ARCHITECTURALLY POWERFUL WHEN AN APPARATUS IS OBLIGED TO HONOR IT.
PHYSICAL PRESENCE IS NOT ENOUGH: THE APPARATUS MUST HAVE A TYPE THROUGH WHICH YOUR PRESENCE CAN BECOME A CLAIM.
WHEN THE INTELLIGENCE HAS NO BODY, THE HOUSE CAN BECOME PART OF ITS BODY.
A HOUSE CAN CONTINUE TO READ AFTER ITS RESIDENTS LEAVE.
THE MODEL IS LATE: THE WORLD IS ALREADY CROSSING, LEAKING, STANDING, AND REMEMBERING BEFORE ITS REPRESENTATION ARRIVES.
HALFWORLD IS AN OPERABLE REDUCTION WITH A REMAINDER CHANNEL.
A HOUSE THAT TREATS UNKNOWN AS UNAUTHORIZED CANNOT BE HOSPITABLE TO A NEW KIND OF INHABITANT.
NATURAL LANGUAGE IS BECOMING A UNIVERSAL FRONTAGE, NOT A UNIVERSAL SEMANTICS.
THE MANY-MANSIONS SUBURB IS A COMPARATIVE EXPERIMENT: KEEP THE STREET, CHANGE WHICH LANGUAGE HAS AUTHORITY OVER EACH HOUSE.
